style: point the listener to one word to listen for

candidates.angle: अशेषेण refers to the totality of beings
द्रक्ष्यसि marks a complete change in perception
यत् points to the knowledge that ends delusion

en.intro: Listen for a single word that marks a complete shift in how you see everything.
en.notice: Once this knowledge is gained, Arjuna will see all beings in himself and then in Krishna, without confusion.
en.next: Krishna says that with the raft of knowledge you will cross all wrongdoing.
en.meaning: Knowing which, you will not fall into confusion again. Through which, you will see all beings without remainder first in yourself, and then in me.

hi.intro: एक शब्द पर ध्यान दीजिए जो देखने के तरीके में पूरा बदलाव ला देता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ज्ञान की नौका से तुम सर्वपाप को पार कर लोगे।
hi.meaning: जिस ज्ञान को पाकर तू फिर इस प्रकार मोह को प्राप्त नहीं होगा, और हे अर्जुन जिस ज्ञान से तू सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों को निःशेष भाव से पहले अपने में और उसके बाद मुझ सच्चिदानन्दघन परमात्मा में देखेगा।

en.intro: Listen for a single word that marks a complete shift in how you see everything.
en.body: Knowing which, you will not fall into confusion again. Through which, you will see all beings without remainder first in yourself, and then in me. Once this knowledge is gained, Arjuna will see all beings in himself and then in Krishna, without confusion. Krishna says that with the raft of knowledge you will cross all wrongdoing.

hi.intro: एक शब्द पर ध्यान दीजिए जो देखने के तरीके में पूरा बदलाव ला देता है।
hi.body: जिस ज्ञान को पाकर तू फिर इस प्रकार मोह को प्राप्त नहीं होगा, और हे अर्जुन जिस ज्ञान से तू सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों को निःशेष भाव से पहले अपने में और उसके बाद मुझ सच्चिदानन्दघन परमात्मा में देखेगा। कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ज्ञान की नौका से तुम सर्वपाप को पार कर लोगे।

issues: wrong_fact: "Listen to अशेषेण, meaning without remainder. This is not a partial vision, but a complete seeing of all beings without any exception." (The NOTICE incorrectly defines 'अशेषेण' as 'without any exception' (बिना किसी अपवाद के), which is a factual misinterpretation. The word means 'without remainder' (बिना शेष के), referring to the totality/completeness of the beings being seen, not the absence of exceptions.)

wrong_fact: "Krishna then says that this knowledge alone will carry you across every wrong act." (The NEXT description is incorrect. Verse 36 says you will cross 'all wrongdoing' (सर्वपाप), not 'every wrong act' (हर गलत काम). More importantly, it is not 'knowledge alone' (ज्ञान ही); it is 'the raft of knowledge' (ज्ञानरूपेण नौधया).)

borrowed: "Next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ज्ञान की नौका से तुम सर्वपाप को पार कर लोगे।" (The 'next' description incorrectly borrows the content of verse 36, which is about crossing all wrongdoing (सर्वपाप) by the raft of knowledge, and applies it to this verse (35), which is about seeing all beings in the self and in Krishna without confusion.)
